name: autopilot-v2-m1-resume-red
title: Autopilot v2 M1: implement checkpoint-ledger-backed resume
description: Implement Autopilot v2 M1 idempotent resume from accepted Red/Repro and Spike evidence. Current autopilotResume hard-refuses healthy non-stale runs; M1 must add a per-run checkpoint ledger, frozen run plan, committed done checkpoint skip semantics, run.json projection replay, stale/plan_drift/corrupt handling, and regression tests that avoid exactly-once overclaims.
